newsitem.title: UK: UK Fidelity Brokerage promises improvement by Jan.
newsitem.headline: UK Fidelity Brokerage promises improvement by Jan.

text.p: Fidelity Brokerage Services, the UK retail stockbroking unit of Fidelity Investments, said it has promised to restore "satisfactory" service to clients by January, after computer problems forced it to stop taking new customers.

Fidelity said in a statement it had agreed with its regulator, the Securities and Futures Authority (SFA), that it would not take on new direct customers until the SFA is satisfied with customer service performance.
Fidelity said its system problems had resulted in accounting and reconciliation problems and promised compensation to any existing customer who has suffered loss as a consequence.
The SFA said it will take further steps in the interests of investors if Fidelity's problems have not been resolved.
